croatia.spiritual_heritage: Cathedral of Saint Domnius in Split, Zagreb Cathedral, Euphrasian Basilica mosaics, and Marian sanctuary of Marija Bistrica
croatia.science_inventions: Nikola Tesla (born in Smiljan), Ruđer Bošković (physicist & astronomer), Slavoljub Penkala (mechanical pen), and Faust Vrančić (parachute pioneer)
croatia.healthcare_longevity: Universal Croatian Health Insurance Fund (HZZO), modern regional clinical hospital centers, and high Mediterranean longevity
croatia.currency_wealth_fund: European Euro (adopted 2023), Croatian National Bank (HNB), and prudent sovereign fiscal reserves
croatia.domestic_rail_transit: Croatian Railways (HŽ) electrified mainlines connecting Zagreb to Rijeka, Split, and Slavonia
croatia.environmental_stewardship: Over 36% of national territory protected under Natura 2000, pristine Adriatic water purity, and reforestation
croatia.national_sports: FIFA World Cup Silver & Bronze football (Luka Modrić), Wimbledon champion Goran Ivanišević, and Olympic water polo gold
croatia.festivals_traditions: Dubrovnik Summer Festival, Sinjska Alka knightly equestrian tournament (UNESCO), and Rijeka International Carnival
croatia.wildlife_fauna: Eurasian brown bear, grey wolf, Eurasian lynx, griffon vultures of Cres island, and Adriatic bottlenose dolphins
croatia.defense_security: Croatian Armed Forces, Croatian Navy (Hrvatska ratna mornarica) Adriatic patrol, and NATO international peacekeeping
croatia.global_diaspora: Vibrant Croatian diaspora of 4 million across North America, South America, Australia, and Western Europe
